value_text: Induced draft cooling of circulating water for LLDPE unit
Reduction of PdO catalyst to Pd using H2 (PdO + H2 -> Pd)
Heat recovered hexane solvent using MP steam before recycle
Collect DA-8910 column overhead condensate; supply reflux & product
4800 mm BOOT WATER DRAW-OFF BOOT DN300
Hexane feed transfer to 1st Polymerization Reactor DC-4501
Compress recycle ethylene/hexane vapour back to reactor loop
Level control of LP Separator FA-6710 bottoms to downstream
Drying of LLDPE polymer powder from centrifuge to < 300 ppm moisture
